objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless item in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying reviewers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers assigned to the document, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity is counted.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date on which validity expires.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification at next version release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution at next version release.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of a released document.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers can see a released language version.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a guideline framework, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Documentation of detailed special work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached when creating a new document or adding additional information or attachments.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing format used to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: office_component
objs.description: Local Office component used by the editing client.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted display format of a saved document on the web.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment released with the main document and subject to versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through in the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Versioning attribute of an attachment.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Validity matching the main document when released.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object used to supplement a document with additional information.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Property switch by which additional information is published.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Property switch by which additional information is released.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant equipment/additional item used to supplement documents and described as reactivated with archived documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user involved with documents, workflows, dashboards, and authorizations.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION for appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: Role shown in brackets for system roles.

attributes.name: author_right
attributes.description: Right allowing employees to create change proposals for a document.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access allowing users to create a request for AKS for a selected document.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: User login language used for document visibility.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual person assigned authorizations, distribution, or workflow participation.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users/persons used for authorizations, reader access, distribution, and dashboards.

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Authorization granted to assigned user groups or persons.

attributes.name: change_right
attributes.description: Right assigned to groups of users/persons for each document.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: System-defined group used to assign read and change rights to users/persons for documents.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: reader_group
objs.description: User group for readers who can view documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: author_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in author or co-author selection lists.

objs.name: reviewer_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in reviewer selection lists.

objs.name: releaser_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in releaser selection lists.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties of a document containing standardized and customer-specific metadata.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific data maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data to which documents can be linked, such as IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: role
objs.description: Implemented role used to provide functions according to area of application.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Group- or person-related permission assigned in document properties.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: Participant allocated in document properties for workflow processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented per released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Individual participant signature documented in the system and printable as document content.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to involved users during workflow and acknowledgement processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the workflow task.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, change proposals, releases, validity extension, distribution, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to an existing document managed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: scheduled_for_implementation
attributes.description: Indicates the change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: Indicates the change proposal is completed.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request used to invalidate or override a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request used to reactivate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of user groups and persons for document distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type informing assigned users and user groups by e-mail when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type requiring assigned persons and users of groups to confirm acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of acknowledgement listed in reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard showing documents and relevant information.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing report evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria filtering report result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: Traffic light display status in reports.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated by status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a document visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Indicates the language version has been released.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.
